data_gaps.reason: The pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain, but do not explicitly state whether bondholder abstention is required in the bondholder meeting context.
The pages state one exercise per interest year after first satisfaction but do not provide a separate annual exercise limit field value.
The put clause uses a continuous 30 trading day window, but the schema field is unresolved because the supplied pages do not separately label it as an observation_window value.
The put clause uses 30 continuous trading days, but the supplied pages do not separately state a required_days count for the put trigger.

The supplied pages describe the down-revision trigger and floor but do not state a distinct adjustment-day treatment rule for the down-revision observation window beyond the general conversion-price adjustment mechanics.
The pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain, but do not explicitly state whether bondholder abstention is required in the bondholder meeting context.
The pages state one exercise per interest year after first satisfaction but do not provide a separate annual exercise limit field value.
The put clause uses a continuous 30 trading day window, but the schema field is unresolved because the supplied pages do not separately label it as an observation_window value.
The put clause uses 30 continuous trading days, but the supplied pages do not separately state a required_days count for the put trigger.
The conditional redemption clause uses 30 continuous trading days, but the supplied pages do not separately label it as an observation_window value.
The conditional redemption clause uses at least 15 trading days, but the supplied pages do not separately state a required_days count for the redemption trigger.
The maturity redemption clause states redemption within five trading days after maturity, but the supplied pages do not provide a numeric day count field for this window.
The pages describe interest payment date deferral and conversion period deferral, but do not provide a single consolidated holiday_deferral_rule value.
The maturity redemption price states 112% including the final interest, but the schema field is unresolved because the supplied pages do not separately state a boolean value.
